title: Privileged Access Rapid Response Kit: RBACv2 + Audit + SSO Support Macros
creator: Asha Menon
description:
Purpose: produce a compact, battle-tested kit for oncall/support engineers to rapidly triage, remediate, and document incidents related to RBAC v2, SAML/SSO, and audit-logging. Scope includes: troubleshooting macros, escalation phrasing, safe temporary elevation steps, audit-query templates, and a minimal operator checklist for private/Dedicated control planes. Exclusions: deep engineering fixes, policy design changes (those are separate RFCs).

Acceptance criteria: 1) A set of 8 support macros covering the top 5 incident classes (permission regression, identity sync failure, audit-log gaps, token misuse alerts, emergency admin restore). 2) A one-page operator checklist that fits in a Slack snippet and contains exact CLI/console steps and safe rollbacks. 3) 2 drills in staging to validate macros and audit query results. 4) Documentation linkable from Support playbook and Console Help.

Success metrics: reduce mean time to resolution for RBAC/SSO incidents by 30% in Q4; reduce support escalations to eng by 20% for permission-related tickets; macros used in >60% of eligible incidents within first month.
acceptance_criteria: 8 support macros covering top incident classes
Operator checklist (Slack-friendly) with exact steps and rollback guidance
Documentation published and linked in Support and Console Help
work_items: Inventory recent RBACv2 incidents and group by root cause (ETA 2d)
Publish artifacts and update internal playbooks (ETA 1d)
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: macros might expose privileged actions; Mitigation: macros only produce guidance and logged CLI snippets, require operator confirmation
Risk: audit queries returning large datasets; Mitigation: include time-windowed queries and post-processing examples
Risk: SAML identity provider variance; Mitigation: include vendor-specific notes for Okta, Azure AD, and generic SAML flows
support_macros:
MACRO: rbac-check-user-perms - Step 1: Run: curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" "https://console.redwood/api/v1/admin/rbac/check?user=$USER&resource=$RESOURCE" --output - | jq '.' 
Action: Paste JSON result into ticket and highlight any missing allow rules. If rules missing, follow 'temp-elevate-safe' macro.

MACRO: temp-elevate-safe - Purpose: grant timeboxed admin to a single user for triage. Steps: 1) Create a grant with expiry: POST /admin/rbac/grants {"user":"$USER","role":"support-triage","expires_at":"$ISO_EXPIRY"} 2) Record grant ID and reason and add to ticket. 3) After validation, revoke immediately or verify automatic expiry. Note: ensure MFA check is passed before granting.

MACRO: saml-sync-debug - Run: /ops/tools/saml-sync status --org $ORG --since 15m --format=json | jq '.'
Look for: failed_assertions, clock_skew_errors, missing_mapped_attributes. Quick fixes: trigger push from IdP or apply transient mapping override in the control plane.

MACRO: audit-gap-query - Example query for last 24h: SELECT timestamp,event_type,user,resource,request_id FROM audit_events WHERE service='control_plane' AND timestamp >= now() - interval '24 hours' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 500;
Tip: narrow by resource or request_id to avoid large results; capture sample request_id to trace through logs and kernel traces.

MACRO: token-abuse-triage - Steps: 1) Identify token fingerprint: curl -s "https://console.redwood/api/v1/tokens?fingerprint=$FINGERPRINT" 2) Revoke token: POST /admin/tokens/revoke {"token_id":"$ID"} 3) Rotate associated service principal and rotate secrets in CI/CD. Add indicator to security incident tracker.

MACRO: emergency-admin-rollback - Scenario: global policy misconfiguration. Steps: 1) Switch control plane to read-only mode (internal endpoint) 2) Apply last known-good policy bundle: POST /admin/policy/apply {"bundle_id":"$BUNDLE"} 3) Run smoke checks (login, token mint, simple generate endpoint). 4) Notify customers via status page if degraded.

MACRO: rbav2-migration-checklist - Validate: role bindings count, duplicate principals, orphaned grants, policy size/limits. Run sampling queries and attach histogram of per-role principal counts to the ticket.

MACRO: escalation-template - Use when operator needs eng: Subject: "RBACv2 incident - [short summary]" Body: include incident time, affected orgs, evidence (audit query), temporary grants applied (IDs), steps taken, and why we need engineering (e.g., policy engine crashed, persistent sync failure). Add links to staging repro if available.
operator_checklist: 1) Confirm scope: which orgs/users/resources are affected (use rbac-check-user-perms macro)
3) Check audit logs for correlated events (audit-gap-query macro)
4) If immediate triage needed, apply temp-elevate-safe and record grant ID
5) If token misuse suspected, revoke and rotate tokens (token-abuse-triage macro)
6) For broad policy regressions, perform emergency-admin-rollback and notify status page
7) After remediation, run postmortem checklist: collect logs, update incident ticket, schedule RCA with Security and Eng
drill_plan: Drill 1: Simulated permission regression in staging org: simulate missing allow rule, use macros to triage and apply temporary grant, then validate and revoke (owner: Liam O'Neill)
Drill 2: Simulated SAML mapping failure: drop attribute mapping in staging IdP and exercise saml-sync-debug macro to restore mapping and validate (owner: Asha Menon)
